$comment: sitespeed.io performance budget for the Tier-1 public pages. Numbers are Core Web Vitals 'good' thresholds (Google, 2024+): LCP 2.5s, CLS 0.1, TTFB 800ms; FCP 1.8s. A budget breach is a signal to the operator, not a deploy block — nickstire has no branch protection. Keys are sitespeed.io 42.7.0 friendly names (lib/support/friendlynames.js, browsertime.*): an unknown key CRASHES the budget plugin (TypeError on .path), it is not ignored — 'ttfb' is spelled backEndTime, CLS lives under pageinfo, not timings.
